notes.title: Enter the realm of Mythical Party! Play with your friends.
notes.notes:
Mythical Party: Steam Next Fest Event

Join us for an exciting event featuring our new party game, Mythical Party! As part of Steam Next Fest, we invite you to experience an unforgettable gaming session with your friends.

Event Details:

Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/6pjwbykkfv]Channel[/url]

Newsletter: [url=https://bosphorusgames.com/mythical-party/]Landing Page[/url]

Mythical Party is a fast-paced, strategic party game for 3-5 players. In each round, players take turns becoming the mythical boss, battling for victory. The game offers a thrilling experience with unique power-ups, environmental hazards, and strategic gameplay mechanics.

During the event:

Meet the developers and learn more about the game.
Get in-game tips and strategies from live streams.
Win special prizes and surprise gifts.
Download our free demo and step into this exciting world with your friends. For more information and to download the free demo, click [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2773720/Mythical_Party/]here[/url]

Unleash your legend and fight for victory with Mythical Party!
